description: This source file defines the DefaultTypeFilter class, implementing a type filtering mechanism for serialization within Orleans. It determines whether specific types or assemblies should be allowed based on name patterns.

classes.name: DefaultTypeFilter
classes.description: A sealed class implementing ITypeNameFilter, designed to allow or disallow certain types based on name patterns for serialization filtering.

methods.name: IsTypeNameAllowed
methods.description: Determines if a type name and assembly name are permitted based on internal rules related to Orleans.Serialization, Exception suffixes, and system type prefixes.
